subject.title: [Feature]: Add runtime testing for skill workshop proposals before apply

question: What execution boundary should OpenClaw allow for pre-apply runtime validation of pending Skill Workshop proposals?
rationale: This is not a narrow bug fix: validating pending generated skills before apply can cross approval, sandbox, tool-policy, network, filesystem, and side-effect boundaries, so automation should not choose the permanent behavior alone.

options.title: Stage smoke validation first
options.body: Add load/discovery/schema validation and health reporting first, and defer real invocation until a sandboxed side-effect contract exists.

options.title: Allow sandboxed invocation
options.body: Permit representative tool invocation only in an isolated runtime with explicit allowed side effects and proposal-provided or generated test oracles.

options.title: Fold into lifecycle contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open as a concrete subtask but require the broader lifecycle contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98002 to define validation authority first.

recommendation.title: Stage smoke validation first
recommendation.body: Add load/discovery/schema validation and health reporting first, and defer real invocation until a sandboxed side-effect contract exists.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Skill Workshop lifecycle approval work makes this the strongest available product/security routing signal.
